s1.title: How would you like to experience BEAM?
s1.intro: Day or night, you stay in the same space: Europe's largest EESystem installation. There is nothing to do. Your body does what it was designed for: recover.

day.title: Day session
day.b1: Welcome with a cup of tea
day.b2: A short introduction to the BEAM space
day.b3: Two hours of rest in a chair or bed
day.b4: A look back and time for questions

night.title: Night session
night.times: From 8 pm to 8 am, Wednesday to Sunday
night.b1: Your own bed in the BEAM space
night.b4: According to inventor Dr Sandra Rose Michael, the most effective form

whatIs.title: What is BEAM?
whatIs.body: A vitality centre in Sint-Martens-Latem, designed to support regulation, recovery and lasting vitality. Not a treatment, an environment.

s2.title: Pick your moment
s2.intro: Green means there is room. Click a time to continue.

tips.title: Good to know
tips.day1: Staying longer? Book two sessions in a row: the hour in between is on us.
tips.day2: Children are welcome on Saturdays from 1 to 3 pm.
tips.day3: Pets are welcome on Mondays from 4 to 6 pm.
tips.night1: You have your own bed, and the space stays calm and stable all night.
tips.night2: Bring comfortable clothes to sleep in.
tips.night3: First time? Many guests start with a day session.

bring.title: What to bring?
bring.body: Comfortable clothes and a bottle of water. Arrive rested if you can; no special preparation is needed.

after.title: After your session
after.body: Take time to rest, drink enough and take a salt bath to support your experience.

package.title: Coming more often?
package.body: Packages of 10 to 100 hours cost less, can be shared with up to five people and stay valid for 18 months. Already have one? Log in to book with your credit.

account.title: Almost there
account.intro: Create your account in one step, so your booking, invoice and next sessions are always at hand.
